WHAT: Two features added to Fashion Finder identify pipeline
1. GENDER DETECTION: Gemini prompt returns { gender: 'men'|'women', items: [...] }. Gender used to select Vinted catalog: men=5, women=1904, men shoes=1231, women shoes=16. Parser handles both old array format and new object format for backward compat.
2. IMAGE DEDUP: SHA-256 hash of base64 image bytes stored as imageHash in Search model. Before calling Gemini, findFirst({ userId, imageHash }). If match found, return cached items (no API call, no usage increment). Rescan uses force=true param to bypass cache.
WHERE: app/api/identify/route.ts, lib/identify-parser.ts, prisma/schema.prisma
